title: Privacy Policy | The Proud Paintbrush
metaDescription: How The Proud Paintbrush collects, uses, and protects your information, including cookies, Google Analytics, and our online booking and video tools.
bodyHtml:
Last updated: June 9, 2026

The Proud Paintbrush LLC ("The Proud Paintbrush," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you visit theproudpaintbrush.com or contact us, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using our website, you agree to the practices described here.

Information We Collect

Information you give us

When you request an estimate, book a walkthrough, call, text, or email us, you may provide your name, phone number, email address, property address, and details about your painting project. You provide this information voluntarily so we can respond to your request and prepare a quote.

Information collected automatically

Like most websites, we automatically collect limited technical information when you browse, such as your IP address, browser and device type, pages viewed, links clicked, and the date and time of your visit. We collect this through cookies and similar technologies (see below).

How We Use Your Information

  • To respond to your inquiries and schedule and prepare painting estimates.
  • To provide, maintain, and improve our services and website.
  • To understand how visitors use our site so we can make it more useful.
  • To follow up about a project, send a quote, or answer a question.
  • To comply with our legal obligations and protect our rights.

Cookies and Analytics

We use Google Analytics 4 to understand how visitors find and use our website. Google Analytics uses cookies to collect information such as the pages you visit and how you arrived at our site. This data is aggregated and helps us improve the site; we do not use it to personally identify you. You can learn more from Google's Privacy Policy, and you can opt out of Google Analytics across all websites by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on. Most browsers also let you block or delete cookies in their settings.

Third-Party Services

Our website relies on a few trusted third parties, each governed by its own privacy policy:

  • Online scheduling (YouCanBook.me): Our "Request a Free Estimate" booking tool is provided by YouCanBook.me. Information you enter to book an appointment is processed by their platform so we can confirm your walkthrough.
  • Video (YouTube / Google): Customer testimonial videos are embedded from YouTube. When you play a video, YouTube may set cookies and collect data under Google's privacy policy.
  • Google Analytics & Google Reviews: We use Google Analytics as described above, and we link to our public Google Business Profile reviews.

We do not control, and are not responsible for, the privacy practices of these third parties. We encourage you to review their policies.

How We Share Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We share information only as needed to operate our business — for example, with the service providers listed above who help us run the website and schedule estimates, or when required by law or to protect our legal rights.

Data Retention

We keep the information you provide for as long as needed to respond to your request, complete your project, and meet our business and legal requirements. You may ask us to delete your information at any time (see below).

Your Choices and Rights

You may request to access, correct, or delete the personal information we hold about you, opt out of analytics tracking (using the tools above), and ask us not to contact you. Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights under laws such as the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act or the California Consumer Privacy Act. To make a request, contact us using the details below and we will respond as required by law.

Children's Privacy

Our website is intended for adults seeking painting services. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us information, please contact us and we will delete it.

Security

We take reasonable steps to protect the information we collect. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

SMS / Text Message Communications

If you provide your mobile number and opt in, The Proud Paintbrush may send you text (SMS) messages related to your estimate, scheduling, project updates, and occasional offers.

Consent: You opt in to text messages by texting a keyword to our number, submitting a form where you check a box to receive texts, or otherwise giving us express written consent. Consent to receive marketing text messages is not a condition of purchasing any goods or services.

Message frequency: Message frequency varies based on your interaction with us (for example, appointment and project-related messages). You may receive recurring messages.

Opt out: You can cancel text messages at any time by replying STOP to any message. After you send STOP, we will send a final message confirming you have been unsubscribed, and you will no longer receive text messages from us. To opt back in, text us again or contact us.

Help: For help, reply HELP to any message, or contact us at (832) 605-0493 or info@theproudpaintbrush.com.

Message and data rates: Message and data rates may apply, depending on your mobile carrier and plan.

Privacy of opt-in data: We do not share your mobile opt-in information or consent with third parties for their own marketing purposes. Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.

Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will revise the "Last updated" date at the top of this page. Significant changes will be reflected here, so please check back periodically.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, contact us:

The Proud Paintbrush LLC
Sugar Land, TX 77498
Phone: (832) 605-0493
Email: info@theproudpaintbrush.com

faqs.q: How do I stop receiving text messages from The Proud Paintbrush?
faqs.a: Reply STOP to any text message from us and you will be unsubscribed; reply HELP for help. Message and data rates may apply, and we do not share your opt-in information with third parties for marketing.
